name: Palm Reader
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of seeking guidance from palm readers and those with familiar spirits, warning God's people not to consult wizards, witches, or enchanters. The Lord commands His people to avoid defilement through such occult practices, declaring that those who turn to these sources will face severe judgment, including being cut off from the community. Instead of seeking the dead or occult powers for knowledge, believers are called to seek the living God alone, trusting in His sovereign provision and wisdom.
